cohort: 537 nulliparous women at 34+0 to 41+6 weeks gestation undergoing cervical ripening by prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) vaginal insert
finding: Among nulliparous women, older maternal age is not associated with higher rates of IoL failure or cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: In nulliparous women, older maternal age was not associated with higher rates of induction of labor failure or cesarean delivery.
